Post 1
📉 ASX 200 shed 4.21% for the period, closing at 8,709.30. A 0.34% bounce on the final session masked a bruising run — the index lost 0.55% in the last five days alone and is virtually flat year to date. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔻 Info Tech cratered 11.64% and Materials fell 9.73% — the two heaviest drags on the ASX 200. Health Care was the lone bright spot, gaining 2.08%. Financials held firm, off just 0.22%. #ASX #ausbiz #tech #materials

Post 3
CODAN LIMITED surged 23.93% to lead the ASX 200, with MEGAPORT LIMITED close behind at +9.44%. Two names bucking a market down 4.21% — standout outperformance in a month where most sectors fell. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
Materials off 9.73% and Info Tech down 11.64% tells the macro story: risk-off pressure hit growth and commodity-linked names hardest. Health Care's +2.08% gain signals a defensive rotation was underway. #ASX #mining #ausbiz

Post 5
ASX 200 sits at 8,709.30, virtually unchanged YTD after a 4.21% slide. Can Health Care's defensive bid hold if Materials and Tech extend losses into October? Bulls or bears — where do you see the index by month-end? #ASX #ausbiz

Post 1

🟢 Property stocks just reminded everyone they still exist. ASX 200 gained 80pts or 0.92% to 8,789.30, led by a rate-sensitive rally. A-REITs surged 3.60% — the clearest signal yet that the market is pricing in easier money ahead. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔺 A-REITs +3.60%, Consumer Discretionary +2.27%, Telcos +1.94%. Rate-sensitive plays dominated. IT was the lone loser, off 0.41%. When property and discretionary run together, the market is betting hard on cuts. #ASX #ausbiz #RBA

Post 3

🏠 LLC surged 11.30% to AUD 2.66 — Lendlease's biggest single-day move in recent memory. With A-REITs ripping 3.60%, the most beaten-down property name caught the most air. Classic sector rotation, compressed into one session. #ASX #property #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,063.18/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6979. A softer Aussie dollar is amplifying local gold returns — Northern Star reflected that, closing up 6.36% to AUD 24.77. Metals are quietly doing heavy lifting. #ASX #gold #mining

Post 5

ASX is flat year-to-date despite today's 0.92% pop. The question is whether this A-REIT rally has legs or fades without a confirmed RBA cut. Watch AUD/USD — does 0.70 hold? If it breaks higher, gold's AUD tailwind narrows fast. Where do you see it? #ASX #RBA #ausbiz
